name: What Mori Keeps
summary: Mori Shade stencils coffin plates for living villagers, at someone's monthly request.

stages.journal: Mori Shade showed us a drawer of coffin plates stencilled with the names of people who are still alive.
objectives: Decide what to do with the list
stages.hint: Decide what to do with the list, at the funeral home.

stages.journal: We chose what to do with Mori's list. The next month's note has not come yet.
stages.hint: See Mori again once the Crooked House is behind us.

waits.text: Mori's next note comes after the Crooked House is behind us.

stages.journal: The next note came, and it named someone we know.
